svg.data-dimensions-note: W 438.5 x D 657.5 x H 43.1 mm (datasheet and guide)
svg.data-input-ac: AC 100 ~ 127 V / 200 ~ 240 V nominal (90-264 V max) at 47-63 Hz
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C at 900 m (datasheet); 0 to 40 C at 950 m (guide)
svg.data-cpu: Intel Xeon-D class, 4 or 8 core, on a COM-E module
svg.data-bmc: RunBMC option (OpenBMC, 2 GB DDR4, dual 128 MB flash)
svg.data-breakout: 8 x 100GbE, 4 x 200GbE or 2 x 400GbE per 800G port
svg.data-optics-osfp: up to 30 W OSFP optics; LPO/LRO support; DAC up to 2.5 m
svg.data-emc: EMC CN (GB9254-2008), EU (EN55022, EN55024), FCC, VCCI
svg.data-environment: EU RoHS, SVHC requirements of REACH, China RoHS
